pages.title: Datapack Overrides
pages.text: Nourished supports $(bold)datapack overrides$() for food group assignments and nutrition values. This allows server owners and modpack makers to reassign any food to a different group or adjust its value without modifying the mod itself.

pages.title: File Location
pages.text:
Place override files at:

$(bold)data/nourished/food_groups/<group>.json$()

Each file is a list of item IDs with optional nutrition value overrides. Entries in your datapack take full priority over the mod's built-in assignments.

pages.title: Example Override
pages.text:
To move $(bold)minecraft:pumpkin_pie$() from Grains to Dairy with a custom value, add its entry to $(bold)data/nourished/food_groups/dairy.json$() and remove it from $(bold)grains.json$().

Changes apply on world load or when datapacks are reloaded with $(bold)/reload$().
